references.text: The Mosaic law allowed the Israelites to take plunder and livestock from cities located far away, unlike the cities in the promised land which were to be completely devoted to destruction.
At Jericho everything was devoted to destruction and destroyed, including livestock, unlike Ai where they were allowed to keep the plunder.
The Lord's command to Joshua that they could take the plunder and livestock from Ai as their own, something this verse shows the fulfillment of.
The Lord's original command to Joshua to follow the law carefully, which Joshua here obeys by acting according to the Lord's word.
An earlier example of Israel taking livestock and plunder as war booty after the Lord's command, during the war against the Midianites.
